description: Incredible opportunity to purchase a single-family home on a large lot and nestled on a tree lined street in Noe Valley!  264 Duncan is situated on a flat street between Church and Dolores with yard space in the front of the property, and a large flat backyard/garden. The home has a flexible floor plan with a living room, dining room, kitchen, bathroom, and two bedrooms all on one level. The kitchen opens to a sunroom/pantry/laundry area with direct access to the sun-drenched backyard with mature landscaping. The lower level of the home has a spacious garage with possible expansion potential. Don't miss this great opportunity that is close to shopping, cafes, restaurants, playgrounds, HWY 101/280 and more!
